text:
emily: Quick note from today's keyboard-only review on Batch > Vectors preview -> Export. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/newflow/vecs-export-keyboard (screenshots attached)

emily: Problem summary: the small hover-only column tooltip + the export format affordance are both unreachable by keyboard and confusing for screen reader users.

maria: thanks. We should make the column info discoverable via keyboard and SR-only. Idea: replace hover tooltip with a focusable "Columns" disclosure button next to the Export CTA that opens a small panel with a selectable header preview.

jamie: +1. Panel should behave like a dialog (role=dialog) with a close button, trap focus, and restore focus to the disclosure button on close. Also keyboard shortcut suggestion: `k` opens columns while modal is open.

lina: Accessibility checklist:
- Columns button: `aria-controls="columns-panel" aria-expanded="false"`
- Panel: `role="dialog" aria-labelledby="columns-title"` and `tabindex="-1"` on the container to receive focus.
- Ensure escaping with ESC and focus return.
- Add SR copy: "Columns included in export: id, embedding_vector, metadata.title".

aqil: Copy tweaks for the export CTA: change ambiguous "Export" -> primary "Download CSV" and secondary chevron reads "Other formats: JSONL, Parquet" (screen-reader: "Open formats menu").

sam: For the columns panel include a one-line CSV header preview that updates as checkboxes are toggled. Make that header selectable/copyable. Example preview:
```
id,embedding_vector,metadata.title,source_url
```
Show sample size estimate: "~2.3 MB for 1k rows".

karen: Microcopy for PII warning: if any chosen field is flagged, show badge: "May contain sensitive data" with link "Learn more" that opens guidance. Also require a secondary confirm checkbox: "I understand this export may contain sensitive text".

lina: For the PII confirm, when the badge appears focus should jump to the checkbox and aria-live announce: "Warning: selected fields may include sensitive data".

jamie: UX constraints: if selection > 1k rows, collapse header preview to a single-line summary and show link "View header sample" that opens the dialog. Avoid heavy DOM for big selections.

emily: Telemetry note: we'll need `export_initiated`, `export_format_selected`, `columns_panel_opened`, and `pii_confirmed` events. @aqil please coordinate with eng to lock event names.

aqil: noted. I'll draft telemetry names and add to the PR. Also updating modal copy in the draft branch.

uxbot: Reminder: add unit tests for keyboard focus order and an accessibility audit before merging.

maria: Action items:
- Emily: update Figma with the Columns disclosure pattern + keyboard shortcut hint
- Lina: add exact aria attributes + SR strings in the spec
- Jamie: implement panel behavior + lazy header preview for large selections
- Aqil: copy + telemetry names + PR
- Sam: size estimate microcopy and selectable header
- Karen: PII warning copy + legal link

maria: Scheduling a 20m sync tomorrow 9:30 to quick-run the Figma changes with Eng. Thanks all :thumbsup:
